Container.Name: Octopus
Container.Overview: Octopus is a self-hosted AI-powered pull request review tool. This template deploys the web application and expects PostgreSQL 15+ and Qdrant to be available. Use the companion Octopus PostgreSQL and Octopus Qdrant templates, then run database migrations after first start.
Container.Requires: Requires PostgreSQL 15+ and Qdrant. Defaults connect to the companion templates through host.docker.internal using ports 43332 and 43333. For production, prefer a user-defined Docker network and change DATABASE_URL/QDRANT_URL to the dependency container names. After first start, run database migrations from an Octopus source checkout with DATABASE_URL pointed at this database: bun run db:migrate.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Octopus web interface port.

Config.Name: DATABASE_URL
Config.Description: Required PostgreSQL connection string for the companion database template. Example format: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@HOST:PORT/DATABASE. Include the POSTGRES_PASSWORD you set for octopus-postgres.

Config.Name: QDRANT_URL
Config.Description: Qdrant HTTP endpoint. Example format: http://HOST:PORT, such as http://host.docker.internal:43333 or http://octopus-qdrant:6333.

Config.Name: QDRANT_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Qdrant API key if Qdrant authentication is enabled.

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_SECRET
Config.Description: Required 64-character random secret. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: BETTER_AUTH_URL
Config.Description: Required public base URL for Octopus. Example format: http://HOST:PORT or https://octopus.example.com. Use your Unraid host URL (e.g., http://192.168.1.100:43300) or reverse-proxy HTTPS URL for OAuth and webhooks. Do not use localhost.

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
Config.Description: Required public app URL exposed to the frontend. Example format: http://HOST:PORT or https://octopus.example.com. Usually the same value as BETTER_AUTH_URL. Do not use localhost.

Config.Name: ENABLE_REVIEW_WORKERS
Config.Description: Set true for a single-container Unraid install so Octopus consumes review jobs.

Config.Name: OPENAI_API_KEY
Config.Description: Required for code embeddings and OpenAI review models.

Config.Name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
Config.Description: Anthropic Claude API key for review models.

Config.Name: GITHUB_APP_ID
Config.Description: GitHub App ID.

Config.Name: GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY
Config.Description: GitHub App private key PEM. If multiline values are not preserved, paste with escaped newline characters.

Config.Name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
Config.Description: GitHub App webhook secret.

Config.Name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth client ID for the GitHub App.

Config.Name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
Config.Description: GitHub OAuth client secret for the GitHub App.

Config.Name: NEXT_PUBLIC_GITHUB_APP_SLUG
Config.Description: GitHub App slug, for example my-octopus-review-app.

Config.Name: GITHUB_STATE_SECRET
Config.Description: Random secret for GitHub OAuth state validation. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: ADMIN_EMAILS
Config.Description: Comma-separated admin email allowlist.

Config.Name: COHERE_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Cohere API key for reranking search results.

Config.Name: RESEND_API_KEY
Config.Description: Optional Resend API key for transactional email.
